branchApplicability.rationale: COPm is explicitly reserve-backed in the pinned issuer configuration, not one of the GBPm/CHFm/JPYm CDP assets. The enumerated pinned Broker mint/burn exchange has external price authority but no borrower-specific liquidation engine. Score this authority as coin-price-feed/top-level-only; branch rows and liquidationDelaySec are not applicable. A 900-second breaker reset cooldown or 360-second report expiry is not a liquidation delay. This review covers canonical Celo exchange pricing and does not classify separate bridge control or remote-chain liquidity.
